experience_source.quote: The qualifications for a certified polysomnographic technologist shall include all of the following: (A) The applicant shall have valid, current credentials as a polysomnographic technologist issued by a national accrediting agency approved by the board. (B) The applicant shall have graduated from a polysomnographic educational program that has been approved by the board. (C) The applicant shall have passed a national certifying examination that has been approved by the board.

definition_quote.value: Polysomnography means the treatment, management, diagnostic testing, control, education, and care of patients with sleep and wake disorders.
definition_quote.quote: "Polysomnography" means the treatment, management, diagnostic testing, control, education, and care of patients with sleep and wake disorders.

value: analysis, monitoring, and recording of physiologic data during sleep and wakefulness
therapeutic and diagnostic use of oxygen
use of positive airway pressure including CPAP and bilevel modalities
maintenance of nasal and oral airways that do not extend into the trachea
methods_authorized.quote: Polysomnography shall also include, but not be limited to, the therapeutic and diagnostic use of oxygen, the use of positive airway pressure including continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) and bilevel modalities, adaptive servo-ventilation, and maintenance of nasal and oral airways that do not extend into the trachea.

value: National accrediting agency approved by the board
credential_body.quote: The applicant shall have valid, current credentials as a polysomnographic technologist issued by a national accrediting agency approved by the board.

value: Polysomnographic educational program approved by the board
Five years of practice in an acceptable manner (grandfathering pathway, prior to three years after effective date)
approved_education_pathways.quote: An applicant for registration as a certified polysomnographic technologist may satisfy the qualifications described in paragraph (1) by submitting proof to the board that they have been practicing polysomnography for at least five years in a manner that is acceptable to the board.

grandfathering_provision.quote: An applicant for registration as a certified polysomnographic technologist may satisfy the qualifications described in paragraph (1) by submitting proof to the board that they have been practicing polysomnography for at least five years in a manner that is acceptable to the board. However, beginning three years after the effective date of this chapter, all individuals seeking to obtain certification as a polysomnographic technologist shall have passed a national certifying examination that has been approved by the board.

value: Supervision: supervising physician and surgeon shall remain available, either in person or through telephonic or electronic means, at the time that the polysomnographic services are provided
supervision_level_definitions.quote: "Supervision" means that the supervising physician and surgeon shall remain available, either in person or through telephonic or electronic means, at the time that the polysomnographic services are provided.

supervising_physician_specialty_required.quote: The individual works under the supervision and direction of a licensed physician and surgeon.

patient_population_restriction.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall be interpreted to authorize a polysomnographic technologist, technician, or trainee to treat, manage, control, educate, or care for patients other than those with sleep disorders or to provide diagnostic testing for patients other than those with suspected sleep disorders.
